question: Compare the HPA blood proximity-extension differential-expression results for Rheumatoid arthritis and Systemic lupus erythematosus, using only comparisons against Healthy controls. Restrict comparisons to Ensembl genes with finite logFC and adjusted p-values in both diseases. Using adjusted p<0.01 and absolute logFC>=0.5, report each disease's up/down counts, the shared upregulated and shared downregulated counts, and the opposing-direction count. Calculate Spearman correlation of logFC across the full common measured universe. Among genes significant in both diseases, select the twelve largest absolute between-disease logFC differences, ties by Ensembl ID. Show both estimates and adjusted p-values, secretome location, and whether each has blood immunoassay and mass-spectrometry measurements. Draw a logFC scatter of the selected twelve genes, a direction overlap table as a heatmap, and a discordance bar chart; provide those plotted data and distinguish proteomic association from causation. If a requested ranked list has fewer eligible members, return every eligible member and state the count. Use Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table as the gene universe and break all gene-ranking ties by Ensembl ID.

turns.text:
## Scope and criteria

I used only the **Healthy** control comparisons in HPA blood proximity-extension-assay (PEA) differential expression. The common analysis universe was restricted to Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table with finite logFC and adjusted *p* values for both diseases: **1,165 genes**.

A gene was called differentially expressed when **adjusted *p* < 0.01** and **|logFC| ≥ 0.5**.

## Summary

| Measure | Result |
|---|---:|
| Rheumatoid arthritis (RA), upregulated | **225** |
| RA, downregulated | **32** |
| Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), upregulated | **427** |
| SLE, downregulated | **32** |
| Shared upregulated | **202** |
| Shared downregulated | **13** |
| Opposing direction | **4** |
| Spearman correlation of logFC, all 1,165 common genes | **0.7600882806968305** |

“Opposing direction” requires that both diseases meet the DE threshold and have opposite signs. The four are all **RA-down/SLE-up**; there are **0** RA-up/SLE-down genes.

## Direction-overlap heatmap

Counts use the same DE threshold above; “neither” means not meeting that disease’s combined adjusted-*p*/effect-size criterion.

| RA \ SLE | Up | Down | Neither |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| **Up** | **202** | **0** | **23** |
| **Down** | **4** | **13** | **15** |
| **Neither** | **221** | **19** | **668** |

Heatmap-style display:

```text
                    SLE
RA             Up       Down     Neither
Up             202      0        23
Down           4        13       15
Neither        221      19       668
```

## Twelve largest between-disease logFC differences

Selection was among genes meeting the DE criteria in **both** diseases, ranked by `abs(RA logFC − SLE logFC)` descending, with ties broken by Ensembl ID. There were at least twelve eligible genes, so twelve are shown.

Blank HPA secretome-location fields are reported as **Not annotated**. “Yes” for blood immunoassay or MS means the Ensembl gene has a record in the corresponding HPA blood-concentration table.

## Scope and criteria

I used only the **Healthy** control comparisons in HPA blood proximity-extension-assay (PEA) differential expression. The common analysis universe was restricted to Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table with finite logFC and adjusted *p* values for both diseases: **1,165 genes**.

A gene was called differentially expressed when **adjusted *p* < 0.01** and **|logFC| ≥ 0.5**.

## Summary

| Measure | Result |
|---|---:|
| Rheumatoid arthritis (RA), upregulated | **225** |
| RA, downregulated | **32** |
| Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), upregulated | **427** |
| SLE, downregulated | **32** |
| Shared upregulated | **202** |
| Shared downregulated | **13** |
| Opposing direction | **4** |
| Spearman correlation of logFC, all 1,165 common genes | **0.7600882806968305** |

“Opposing direction” requires that both diseases meet the DE threshold and have opposite signs. The four are all **RA-down/SLE-up**; there are **0** RA-up/SLE-down genes.

## Interpretation boundary

These are **proteomic associations** from HPA PEA blood differential-expression comparisons versus Healthy controls. The logFC differences, overlap counts, blood-detectability flags, and secretome annotations do **not** establish that a protein causes RA, SLE, or the observed disease differences. They may reflect disease biology, immune-cell composition, treatment, comorbidity, assay characteristics, or other confounding factors.
